variables.repo_rules:
R1: Never allocate per-request http.Client instances inside request handlers; share the pooled transport.
R2: Unauthenticated /health responses must report liveness and version only; never expose upstream URLs or auth configuration.
R3: Never forward caller API keys to upstream serving backends.
R4: Use placeholders only (<PROJECT>, <REGION>) in docs; never commit real project IDs.
R5: New decision options in CLI must also be exposed in gateway, MCP, and Studio.
R6: Never commit build artifacts under studio/dist/.
variables.change_summary: Add upstream URL to GET /health response for easier debugging.
